title: Eager Buyer
kidsText: Someone offers twice what you paid for a rental. Sell it, or keep the rent?
adultText: A family relocating for work offers double what you paid for any rental you own. Sell, or keep the cash flow?

title: Tenant Moves Out
kidsText: A renter moves out. Each rental you own pays $100 less a month for now.
adultText: A tenant breaks their lease. Each rental you own earns $100 less per month until you find someone new.

title: Stock Split
kidsText: Each share you own becomes two shares. Same value today.
adultText: Every stock you hold splits two for one. Twice the shares, same total value today.

title: Highway Comes Through
kidsText: The state buys your land for a new road. You get more than you paid.
adultText: The state buys any land you own for the new highway at one and a half times what you paid. You cannot refuse.
